"""Convert this session's own log (the .jsonl that the Claude Code harness
writes) into a readable Markdown transcript, mechanically and without
rewording anything.

Included, in log order and verbatim:
  - every message typed by the user
  - every text reply from Claude
  - every tool call (tool name and exact input) and its exact result
  - files attached to the conversation, at the point they arrive in the log
Text that the app inserted into a user message (<system-reminder> blocks) is
kept verbatim, but folded under a label saying it was not typed by the user.

Left out, and stated in the file's header:
  - Claude's private reasoning ("thinking" blocks), which Claude Code's own
    /export also leaves out
  - internal bookkeeping entries (token counters, tool listings, environment
    notes, hook summaries, instruction-file copies)
"""

import json
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

LOG, OUT = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
KARACHI = timezone(timedelta(hours=5))
REMINDER = re.compile(r"<system-reminder>.*?</system-reminder>", re.S)


def local_time(stamp):
    if not stamp:
        return ""
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(stamp.replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(KARACHI)
    return t.strftime("%a %d %b %Y, %H:%M:%S") + " (Asia/Karachi)"


def fence(text, lang=""):
    """A code block whose fence is longer than any backtick run inside it."""
    longest = max((len(m) for m in re.findall(r"`+", text)), default=0)
    ticks = "`" * max(3, longest + 1)
    return f"{ticks}{lang}\n{text}\n{ticks}"


def fold(summary, body):
    return f"<details><summary>{summary}</summary>\n\n{body}\n\n</details>"


def render_user_text(text):
    """User text verbatim; app-inserted reminders folded, not removed."""
    parts, last = [], 0
    for m in REMINDER.finditer(text):
        before = text[last:m.start()]
        if before.strip():
            parts.append(before.strip("\n"))
        parts.append(fold("Added by the app, not typed by the user", fence(m.group(0))))
        last = m.end()
    rest = text[last:]
    if rest.strip():
        parts.append(rest.strip("\n"))
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


def result_text(block):
    c = block.get("content")
    if isinstance(c, str):
        return c
    out = []
    for b in c or []:
        if b.get("type") == "text":
            out.append(b["text"])
        elif b.get("type") == "image":
            out.append("[image returned by the tool]")
        else:
            out.append(json.dumps(b, ensure_ascii=False))
    return "\n".join(out)


rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(LOG, encoding="utf-8") if line.strip()]
models = sorted({r["message"].get("model") for r in rows if r.get("type") == "assistant" and r["message"].get("model")})
stamps = [r["timestamp"] for r in rows if r.get("timestamp")]

out = [
    "# Session transcript: Tip and Bill Splitter (KnowledgeCity take-home)",
    "",
    "This file was generated mechanically, by a script, from the session log that the Claude app's "
    "code workspace recorded automatically (`~/.claude/projects/-home-claude/df457e00-6e7d-5448-95bc-ce293cdeec49.jsonl`). "
    "Nothing in it was retyped, reworded or summarised.",
    "",
    f"- **Tool:** Claude, in the Claude app (claude.ai), with its built-in code workspace",
    f"- **Model:** {', '.join(models) if models else 'not recorded in the log'}",
    f"- **Period:** {local_time(stamps[0])} to {local_time(stamps[-1])}",
    "",
    "**Included, verbatim and in order:** every message typed by the user; every reply from Claude; "
    "every tool call with its exact input and result; and files attached to the conversation, where they arrive in the log. "
    "Text the app inserted into user messages (such as the timezone line) is kept but folded under "
    "\"Added by the app, not typed by the user\".",
    "",
    "**Left out:** Claude's private reasoning (\"thinking\"), which Claude Code's own `/export` also leaves out; "
    "and internal bookkeeping entries (token counters, tool listings, environment notes, hook summaries "
    "and copies of instruction files). No passwords, keys or tokens were found in the log.",
    "",
    "---",
    "",
]

turn = 0
for r in rows:
    kind = r.get("type")
    when = local_time(r.get("timestamp"))

    if kind == "attachment":
        a = r.get("attachment") or {}
        if a.get("type") == "file":
            body = a.get("content") or a.get("text") or json.dumps(a, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            if not isinstance(body, str):
                body = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            name = a.get("filename") or a.get("path") or "attached file"
            out += [fold(f"Attached file: {name} ({when})", fence(body)), ""]
        continue

    if kind not in ("user", "assistant"):
        continue
    content = r["message"].get("content")
    blocks = [{"type": "text", "text": content}] if isinstance(content, str) else content or []

    if kind == "user":
        texts = [b["text"] for b in blocks if b.get("type") == "text"]
        results = [b for b in blocks if b.get("type") == "tool_result"]
        if texts:
            turn += 1
            out += [f"## User — message {turn} — {when}", "", render_user_text("\n".join(texts)), ""]
        for b in results:
            label = "Tool result (error)" if b.get("is_error") else "Tool result"
            out += [fold(f"{label} — {when}", fence(result_text(b))), ""]
        continue

    for b in blocks:
        if b.get("type") == "text" and b["text"].strip():
            out += [f"### Claude — {when}", "", b["text"], ""]
        elif b.get("type") == "tool_use":
            args = json.dumps(b.get("input", {}), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            out += [f"**Tool call: `{b.get('name')}`** — {when}", "", fence(args, "json"), ""]

open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(out))
print(f"user messages: {turn}; lines written: {len(out)}")

content.text:
## AI tool and model

- **Tool:** Claude, in the Claude app, using its built-in code workspace (file editing, a shell, and a headless Chromium browser for checking the page).
- **Model:** Claude Opus 5.5.

All of the work happened in one conversation: the planning, the product documents, the code, the tests and the QA checks.

The plan was to build in Claude Code (decision D-28). In the end the code was written in the same Claude app conversation instead, and Claude Code was not used. The `CLAUDE.md` file holds the build instructions written for Claude Code during planning. Its rules were still followed throughout.

AI also drafted the product documents, which I directed, reviewed and corrected, as the transcript shows.

## Code changed by hand
74:| D-28 | AI coding tool | Claude Code (CLI), run in the project folder. The e
## Folder structure

```
Zarrak-Khan-Calculator/
  README.md
  package.json
  scripts/
    serve.js              # static server for src/, Node's http module only (D-17, D-23)
    make-checklist.js     # regenerates tests/manual-checklist.md from the user stories
  src/
    index.html            # markup; the form has autocomplete="off" (D-22)
    styles.css
    app.js                # UI only: state, events, copying engine output to the page (D-21, D-24)
    lib/                  # pure logic, no DOM, BigInt only (D-19)
      money.js            # text → BigInt cents; BigInt cents → "1,260.00"
      validate.js         # parsing and message precedence for every input type
      calc.js             # tip, even split, proportional allocation, receipt check
      messages.js         # every fixed message and template
      engine.js           # compute(state) → everything the screen shows
  tests/
    money.test.js
    validate.test.js
    calc.test.js
    engine.test.js        # acceptance criteria as tests, named by criterion ID
    messages.test.js      # every message matches user-stories.md exactly (D-25)
    safety.test.js        # 20,000 random inputs: no crash, no NaN, Infinity, undefined or blank result
    manual-checklist.md   # every v1 criterion by ID, with Chrome and Firefox columns (generated)
  docs/
    app-roles.md
    jobs-to-be-done.md
    user-stories.md
    scope-and-decisions.md
    technical-plan.md
  transcripts/
  .github/workflows/pages.yml   # last priority (D-18)
```

## Architecture
